subject: FinConnect - security questionnaire kickoff & decision roster
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@finconnect.com>, Vivian Lee <vivian.lee@finconnect.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: FinConnect - post-demo recap & next steps (security questionnaire kickoff)

Thanks again for the call today — great to meet the FinConnect team. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on scope and who owns what.

High-level outcome
- FinConnect is interested in a pilot to evaluate Redwood inference for transaction enrichment (mobile + nightly batch) with a view to a Q4 rollout if performance and controls check out.

Stakeholders (as discussed) — please confirm the owner for each:
- Economic buyer: Priya Sethi (CFO) — finance approvals and PO (FinConnect)
- Product sponsor: Sanjay Rao (VP Product) — product/UX success metrics
- Security lead: Vivian Lee (Security Engineer) — technical scope, evidence, and SOC2 review
- Procurement/legal: Elena Morris (ProcurePlus) — contract lead and procurement checklist

Immediate asks from Redwood
1) Please complete the security questionnaire we shared (attached our template in case you want to start from it). If you prefer, you can return your own spreadsheet — we can intake either format.
2) Provide a short list of systems in scope (APIs, S3 buckets, batch pipelines, third-party connectors). A simple one-pager or diagram works.
3) Confirm the economic buyer and target timeline for procurement (PO/DocuSign).

Proposed timeline
- 48h: FinConnect returns questionnaire + systems-in-scope draft
- Week of Sep 6: Security scoping call with Vivian + Redwood SEs to walk through answers and boundary questions
- Sep 10–17: Procurement review and initial redlines (if any)

Attachments: rdw-questionnaire-template.xlsx (Redwood questionnaire template)

Happy to adjust — suggested times for the scoping call are Tue 9/7 10–11am PT or Wed 9/8 2–3pm PT.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Tessa — thanks for the clear recap. Attaching two files that should help: FinConnect_Security_Questionnaire_answers_v1.xlsx (we answered the questionnaire inline) and FinConnect_Systems_Roster.pdf (very short list and asset owners).

Quick confirmations:
- Economic buyer: Priya Sethi (cc'd via her assistant — she asked us to loop Elena on procurement).
- Security lead: Vivian Lee (cc'd) will lead the technical scoping.
- Procurement: Elena is handling SOW/MSA and will share procurement timelines; she typically needs 2–3 weeks for initial review plus vendor security attestation.

Notes on systems roster (high level)
- Mobile app API (api.finconnect.com) — used by Redwood for real-time enrichment
- Nightly batch ingestion (s3://finconnect-data/inbound -> ETL -> inference)
- Sandbox environment (non-PHI, anonymized samples) for pilot

We don't have a final network diagram ready; Vivian will send a stub. Thanks for the proposed call windows — Tue 9/7 10am PT works for us.

Sanjay

Perfect — appreciate the fast turnaround and the attachments. A few follow-ups from Redwood before the scoping call: 

1) Mapping of owners for questionnaire questions — Priyom will own technical controls answers (SE-run), Ben will take operational/SRE questions, and I will coordinate procurement/legal.
2) Could Vivian attach the network diagram stub when convenient? Even a one-slide sketch is sufficient for the scoping call.
3) Procurement note for Elena: we typically roll with our standard MSA + SOW. If FinConnect needs vendor-specific language, please flag the sections you want to redline early; that speeds review. We can also provide an auditor contact (SOC2 report) under NDA.

Action items / mutual action plan
- FinConnect: return any clarifications inline in the questionnaire (Sanjay) + add network diagram (Vivian) — due by 9/2 EOD
- Redwood: Priyom and Ben to review answers and prepare open questions for 9/7 call; Tessa to share SOC2 access instructions and draft SOW template by 9/3

I've attached a stub network-diagram-stub.png (SE request) and our rdw-questionnaire-template.xlsx again for reference. Please confirm Tue 9/7 10am PT for the scoping call and we'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to the call,
Tessa Morgan

Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinConnect - scoping prep (systems boundary clarifications)

Vivian / Sanjay — quick SE note to help scope tomorrow's call:

- Based on your roster, primary in-scope items for the pilot are the mobile app API (real-time inference) and the nightly batch pipeline (S3 -> ETL -> inference). For the scoping call, please confirm:
  * Whether the batch pipeline will send PII or if records are anonymized/pseudonymized prior to S3. That materially changes encryption and retention controls.
  * Whether you will require IP allowlisting or a VPC peering/private deployment for pilot (we support both hosted + private options).
  * Expected retention windows for logs and any audit data (redwood default 30 days unless otherwise requested).

If you can add those three bullets to the systems roster PDF or put the answers inline in the questionnaire we'll be able to prepare targeted remediation/evidence for the call.

Looking forward to the 9/7 10am PT slot — sending a calendar invite now.

Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
